name: OpenTelemetry
purpose: Vendor-neutral traces, metrics and logs with SDKs and collectors.

name: Prometheus
purpose: Metrics collection, querying and alerting.

name: Grafana
purpose: Operational dashboards and visualization.

name: Loki
purpose: Log aggregation and querying from Grafana Labs: indexes log labels rather than full text, so it is cheaper than Elasticsearch for logs but weaker at full-text search.

name: Jaeger
purpose: Distributed trace storage and inspection.

name: Sentry
purpose: Error reporting and application performance tooling.

name: Serilog
purpose: Structured logging for .NET with sinks to files, consoles, and log services; the de facto standard .NET logging library.

name: structlog
purpose: Structured Python logging that produces machine-readable (JSON) log events; pairs with standard-library logging or as a standalone pipeline.

name: Pino
purpose: Structured JavaScript/Node.js logging built for speed, emitting JSON in production; transports run out-of-process to keep the event loop free.

name: Tracy
purpose: Native and real-time application profiling.

name: RenderDoc
purpose: Graphics frame capture and debugging for Vulkan, D3D, and OpenGL: inspect draw calls, resources, and pipeline state frame by frame; not a profiler for CPU code.

name: Wireshark
purpose: Network protocol inspection and troubleshooting.

name: AppTrail
purpose: Local Windows folder snapshots, named project checkpoints, Git details, saved source diffs and HTML change reports. MIT; unsigned x64 portable release; snapshots are observations, not backups.

name: BuildTrail
purpose: Local Windows build recipes, compiler/tool probes, dependency-manifest evidence, logs, output hashes and AppTrail source comparisons. MIT; unsigned x64 portable app; manifests are not a complete installed dependency graph.

name: Microsoft Attack Surface Analyzer
purpose: Compare system security configuration snapshots with broad collectors and local SQLite evidence. MIT; README and license read 2026-10-22. Runtime, release maintenance and Windows compatibility need validation; not executed.

name: WinLedger
purpose: Local Windows before/after sessions for registry, services, tasks, startup, environment, firewall and selected files; conservative rollback. MIT license and README read 2026-10-22; Windows 11 x64/.NET 10 documented, not independently tested or adopted.

name: Dumpling (.NET heap analysis)
purpose: Apache-2.0 CLI and MCP candidate for .NET heap comparisons, retention paths and dominator analysis. Upstream documents .gcdump and ClrMD process-dump support; unarchived, repository pushed 2026-08-14. Validate format fidelity, memory use, distribution and supported runtimes before reuse.

name: dotnet-heapview
purpose: MIT desktop heap viewer, shared heap model and MCP source example. Upstream lists .gcdump, .hprof and .mono-heap inputs; unarchived, repository pushed 2026-09-21. Compare PerfView and Dumpling; GUI completeness, packaging and Windows runtime support remain untested.

name: HeapTrail for .NET
purpose: Free MIT Windows x64 .NET heap investigation desktop: compare .gcdump counts/shallow bytes, inspect root/incoming/outgoing paths, save notes and export local HTML. Unsigned self-contained preview; no live attachment, retained-size/dominator analysis or allocation stacks.

name: OpenObserve
purpose: Store and query operational telemetry; review resource sizing and edition licensing.

name: VictoriaMetrics
purpose: Store and query time-series metrics; compare single-node, cluster and enterprise capabilities.

name: Pyroscope
purpose: Collect and explore continuous profiles; account for language-agent support and sampling overhead.

name: Tempo
purpose: Store distributed traces; plan object storage and telemetry ingestion limits.

name: Parca
purpose: Profile workloads continuously; confirm platform and symbolization support.

name: bpftrace
purpose: Trace Linux behavior with eBPF scripts; validate kernel features and required privileges.

name: Pixie
purpose: Observe Kubernetes workloads through automatic instrumentation; assess eBPF and cluster requirements.

name: Glances
purpose: Inspect host and container metrics; configure authentication for exposed monitoring endpoints.

name: bottom
purpose: View system utilization in a terminal; compare per-platform metric availability.

name: bandwhich
purpose: Attribute network bandwidth to local processes; inspect operating-system and privilege requirements.

name: memray
purpose: Memray is a memory profiler for Python (from Bloomberg): tracks allocations to find leaks and hot spots in long-running processes.

name: GoModel
purpose: AI gateway / AI control plane / AI proxy written in Go. Unified OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible API for OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, xAI, Ollama, vLLM and more. A LiteLLM alternative with observability, guardrails, streaming, cost tracking, intelligent routing, sticky sessions, failover, real-time logs and usage tracking. Prod ready.

name: zipkin
purpose: Zipkin is a distributed tracing system: collects and visualises request traces across services (OpenZipkin); OpenTelemetry is the newer instrumentation standard feeding it.

name: flogger
purpose: A Fluent Logging API for Java

name: rustnet
purpose: Per-process network monitoring for your terminal with deep packet inspection. Cross-platform, sandboxed.
